AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#362 @ 261e7d4c37429c65bf8e84468c5521380ff5b0cc — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/2/2

Independent T4 short delta, AUD-SOL-H46F-119, agent 119.

### Prior finding disposition

The original successful-storage **B-362-7** held-native and queued-grant resurrection cases are repaired: stop health work synchronously, bump write epoch/void old grants before any await, drop queued writes, and remove health keys within the same queue after the native operation in flight. Original actual signOut/Connect/Refresh five-case spec and seven drain controls pass; **B-362-2/6 remain closed**. Single rejected-grant C-362-13 case now passes with null, but overlapping rejected grants remain a C below. [Prior Sol verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5984939067), [Current fix](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5985130217), [Independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240314801).

G09 reuse is limited to unchanged prior-reviewed source and piece boundaries. The complete two-file H4 delta and both new H5 test suites were read; H4 auth/state blobs match H6 top exactly. Eight prior H5 test blobs match, pure H5/H6 merge trees equal their head trees, H6 own aggregate and all 19 per-path patch-ids match the previous own approval. No candidate production edits in probes. [H5 round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/363#issuecomment-5985132233), [H6 restack](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/364#issuecomment-5985132396).

### B-362-8 — Failed removal plus restart restores voided phone authorization

Promotes disclosed **C-362-14**: `src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts:120-122,173-175,221-228`. The sign-out epoch and revocation watermark exist only in JS memory; enumeration/removal errors are swallowed and the disk grant stays. Actual signOut completes, the in-run getter returns null, but a fresh module lifetime retaining the same disk service resets the watermark and actual `refreshOnDevice` for the same user/server-connected row returns **imported**, expected **not_authorized**, without any new Connect. Both getAllKeys failure and health-prefix removeMany failure reproduce it; transient I/O is restored before restart, and the persisted-grant positive/successful-sign-out negative controls pass. [Exact-H4 failure-recovery proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240405511), [Independent exact-top corroboration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240314801).

This is the same explicit local-consent invariant as B-362-7, not optional just because one I/O rejects. It is a synthetic storage/restart counterexample, not hardware reproduction, actual health data, network upload, cross-account access or current-fence bypass. Minimal fix rule: make revocation survive process lifetime (durable invalidation/current-session binding or startup cleanup retry), fail closed on uncertain cleanup, and require a new Connect before an old grant can authorize refresh. Add both actual signOut + restart cases and preserve ordinary grant-persistence and successful-clear controls. [Failure-recovery proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240405511).

### B-362-9 — Another cleanup rejection skips the awaited health drain

`src/services/authActions.ts:299,386-409,447`: placing `healthStateRetired` inside Promise.all is not a guaranteed drain. When clearUserCache or clearAllStorage rejects first, Promise.all rejects, the catch proceeds, logout emits and actual signOut resolves while the native health grant write is still held and its queued sweep has not run. Both rejection cases observe **completedBeforeCommit = true**, expected false; the no-rejection wait control passes. The test always releases the held native completion before asserting, so no test-driver deadlock is a finding. [Exact-H4 held-write proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240405511).

Minimal fix rule: await the already-started health retirement unconditionally after/finally around best-effort cleanup, before logout and function resolution, independently of any other cleanup rejection. Keep synchronous session stop/queued-write invalidation first; cover both other-storage failures and the successful-cleanup wait control. This also protects the account-deletion path that calls signOut. [Exact-H4 proof and deletion controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240405511).

### Evidence and optional findings

Independent exact-top execution `ad4ccbecab757392a9a6523dbb473e142c061797` (#364 + test-only `73233e7` + lane): **2 new restart failures / 752 pass**, 61/62 suites pass. Independent exact-H4 execution `733f5bbf5c8bd52a0b1a06d73a2faf1a0cb8b030` (#362 + test-only `92d8486` + lane): **4 failure-recovery invariants fail / 140 controls pass**, 10/11 suites pass. No setup failures; original prior Sol sign-out, native-order, session/transport/retry, both-model supported-flow and new drain controls pass. Opus's old single rejected-grant expectation was flipped to null; the obsolete Samsung wire identity expectation was replaced by the unchanged adapted mirror control, not called a flake. [Independent top execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240314801), [Independent exact-H4 execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240405511).

- **C-362-13 remainder:** `src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts:152-160,267`: two overlapping same-key rejected grant writes reserve sequences s+1 and s+2. The first failure cannot roll back because the map holds s+2; the second restores its captured predecessor s+1, even though that predecessor also failed. A Disconnect captured at s then incorrectly preserves the old grant. Independent narrow execution: **1 failed / 8 passed**, with the successful-later-write control passing. Restore the latest successful grant credit, not an arbitrary predecessor reservation. This is optional under the prior Disconnect/remote-revocation boundary, not a claimed server-revocation bypass. [Narrow exact-H4 failed-grant proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37240711684), [Prior C-362-13 disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5984831539).
- **C-362-5 retained:** `src/screens/client/wearables/HealthFitnessScreen.tsx:147-156,207-209,265-287,312-318`: model primary/secondary query loading/error/stale/retry/refresh jointly, with RHR-only and secondary-failure controls; operator tickets under freeze. [Prior Sol disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5984939067).

Size 2,983 within its grandfathered 3,000 ceiling; only 17 lines of headroom, so do not squeeze away the privacy invariant to fit. Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test succeeds; Analyze absent on stacked bases, not green. Recommended defaults: fix B-362-8/9 rather than accept C-362-14; KEEP grandfathered H5; ticket optional Cs; retain land-as-one/main-based checks and separate native/device/privacy/flag gates. No merge/deploy/native acceptance claimed. [Round/size](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5985130217), [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37239676176/job/111545672427).
